description.sub_name: 國際經營管理專題研究
description.sub_ename: THE RESEARCH ON THE ISSUES OFINTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
description.describe_ch: 課程目的在於透過實務參訪，廣邀業界經理人演講等方式產生研究專題，學生進而提供問題解決方法或因應對策，同時也讓學生瞭解國際經營管理之實際管理及策略運作方式。
description.describe_eh: The objective of this course is designed to introduce students how to write a research report by using business research method. The main topics include: research background, motivation, objectives, literature review, research structure, research flowchart, research design, data collection and basic statistical methods. Meanwhile, the research topic will be related to international business management.
